items.headline: Hawaii squares off against New Mexico State
items.description: New Mexico State (1-1) at Hawaii (0-2), Sept. 12 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Thomas and Arnold lead UNLV past Hawaii 21-6 to win fourth straight Island Showdown
items.description: — Jai'den Thomas rushed for 143 yards and a touchdown, Jackson Arnold rushed for 89 yards and two scores along with 116 passing yards, and UNLV weathered Hawaii's attempted comeback in a 21-6 victory on Saturday night.

items.headline: Stanford use fourth-quarter flurry to win opener over Hawai'i
items.description: Tavita Pritchard, the former Stanford quarterback who is now the Cardinal coach, watched his team pull off a furious rally after nearly blowing a 16-point lead in the fourth quarter to defeat Hawaii 37-27.

items.description: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors vs. Stanford Cardinal: Full Highlights

items.headline: Stanford gets a late TD from Micah Ford to avoid a 4th quarter collapse in 37-27 win vs Hawaii
items.description: — Micah Ford scored his third touchdown on a 2-yard run with 1:41 to play and Stanford rallied after nearly blowing a 16-point lead in the fourth quarter to beat Hawaii 37-27 on Saturday in the first game under new coach Tavita Pritchard.
